subject: MedixSys: Hosted API deep-dive - scheduling and prep
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@medixsys.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 16:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Hosted API - deep-dive request

Hi Irene / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick responses earlier in procurement. MedixSys is ready to move from trial to a production proof-of-concept and we'd like to schedule a technical deep-dive to scope the Hosted API integration. High-level agenda we want to cover:
- SDKs (Python + Node) and recommended client patterns for long-running calls
- Streaming responses (partial tokens, reconnect behavior)
- Function/tool calling: expected payloads, error handling, and guardrails
- Auth & token rotation (KMS/HSM questions)
- Observability: tracing, token-level cost breakdowns, and logs retention

Proposed slots (our timezone PST):
- Thu Dec 3, 10:00 - 11:00
- Fri Dec 4, 14:00 - 15:00
- Mon Dec 7, 09:00 - 10:00

I've attached a 1-page summary of our integration goals so you can see our data flows (MedixSys-Integration-Goals.pdf).

Attendees on our side: me (SRE lead), Andrew Li (Platform eng), and maybe our product manager depending on timing.

Can you confirm availability and who from Redwood should join (we want both API/product and an engineer for runtime questions)?

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
SRE Lead, MedixSys
sofia@medixsys.com

[Attachment: MedixSys-Integration-Goals.pdf]

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@medixsys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 18:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Hosted API - deep-dive request

Hi Sofia — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the note + the goals doc.

We can cover everything on your agenda. Proposed Redwood attendees:
- Irene Choi (Solutions, API surface and rollout policy)
- Karthik Iyer (Runtime engineer — streaming/KV cache/latency tradeoffs)
- Ava Chen (Product, observability & billing instrumentation)
- Marissa Cole (Customer success, rollout & success plan)

From your proposed slots the Fri Dec 4, 14:00 - 15:00 PST works best for our team. If that is still available on your side, we'll send a calendar invite and an invite link. If you need an earlier slot, Thu Dec 3 10:00 PST is possible but Karthik will be on a short window.

Quick asks so we can prep a compact runbook:
- Can you share a representative example of a streaming session (avg tokens per session, expected concurrent sessions)?
- Any special compliance concerns (PII, region restrictions) we should plan for?

I've attached a short Redwood Hosted API architecture brief we typically share for these sessions (redwood-hosted-arch-brief.pdf).

If Fri the 4th is good, we'll plan for a 60-min deep-dive with a 15-min focused Q/A for runtime hooks.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

[Attachment: redwood-hosted-arch-brief.pdf]

Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:10:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: MedixSys: Hosted API deep-dive - scheduling and prep

Team — forwarding Sofia's goals + our reply. Short plan for prep before Fri:
- Karthik: please prepare a 10-min runtime slide covering streaming guarantees (partial tokens, reconnect semantics), KV cache behavior for repeated prompts, and expected perf on a 2–4k token window.
- Ava: bring a quick view of tracing -> cost mapping and retention policy; have a pointer to the console dashboard we can demo.
- Marissa: I'll draft a 30/60/90 success plan skeleton we can present at the end.

Also let's rehearse the demo transitions: 15 min architecture + integration patterns, 20 min live SDK demo (Python streaming sample), 15 min deep runtime Q/A, 10 min rollout/next steps.

We should also confirm whether MedixSys needs private deployment details; pack a couple of slides but only go there if asked.
